text:
sam.design: Pushed a mini-proto for a 'feather' onboarding card in the hero. It's compact by default, expands to show 3 sample projects, and can also surface a quick checklist. Want quick takes on copy, a11y, and whether to prefer a persistent banner vs this compact card.

eva.product: Nice. Main product Q: do we treat samples as a separate discovery surface or part of the core setup checklist? My instinct: checklist should be primary (API key, project), samples optional but visible. Metrics: measure sample launch rate and time-to-first-success.

omar.eng: Tech notes: card expands client-side, we can lazy-load sample thumbnails. Persist dismiss server-side for logged users, localStorage for guests. If we do a banner variant, it's one-off faster to ship. Compact card needs focus management work.

riley.a11y: Accessibility quick hits: 
- Add `aria-expanded` on the card toggle and update label: "Welcome card, collapsed" -> "Welcome card, expanded".
- When expanded, move focus to first interactive sample. If it's a panel (inline), don't trap focus; if modal, use `role=dialog` + `aria-modal=true`.
- Announce dynamic changes with `aria-live=polite` for completions and `role=status` for microcopies.
- Avoid CTAs like "Try" alone; use "Launch Chat demo" or "Run sample project".

sam.design: Copy drafts: Variant 1: Headline "Get started with Redwood" / CTA primary "Create your first project" / Secondary "Launch Chat demo (2m)" / Helper "No code required". Variant 2: Headline "See Redwood in action" / CTA "Launch Chat demo" / Secondary "Create project". Thoughts?

eva.product: Prefer Variant 1 for clarity. Also suggest showing ETA on samples, e.g., "~2 min" badge. Add analytics events: `onboard.feather_shown`, `onboard.feather_expand`, `onboard.sample_launch`, `onboard.checklist_action`. Tag with `variant`. Rollout 10% new orgs for 7 days.

omar.eng: Will wire events. Small example for tracking: ```track('onboard.sample_launch', { sample: 'chat-demo', variant: 'A' })``` Also: detect existing projects and change primary CTA to "Open your project" to avoid conflicting CTAs.

riley.a11y: Motion & contrast nits: 
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for expand animation (don't animate on reduce).
- In dark mode the CTA color needs checking; current mock is 3.2:1. We need 4.5:1 for normal text (or ensure larger text size).
- When a checklist item completes, announce: "API key created" via live region.

sam.design: Good catches. For keyboard flow: toggle is tabbable; when expanded, first sample gets focus. ESC collapses and returns focus to toggle. Also show a visible focus ring for sample cards.

eva.product: Also decide: pulse highlight on first login to draw attention? If used, must respect reduced-motion and screen-reader heuristics. Only pulse for orgs with zero projects. Track `feather.pulse_shown` and `feather.pulse_dismissed`.

omar.eng: Pulse is doable with a one-time CSS animation + flag in localStorage. We'll skip pulse if `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. For logged users we'll persist server-side.

riley.a11y: One UX copy note: for personalized suggestions avoid 'We think you'll like X' phrasing. Use 'Suggested for you: Chat demo' or 'Recommended sample: Chat demo'. Clear and concise helps SR users.

sam.design: Action items: 
- Lock copy to Variant 1 for initial experiment + add ETA chips
- Implement focus rules + aria attributes (riley)
- Server-side dismissal for auth users + localStorage fallback (omar)
- Add events list for product (eva)

eva.product: I'll create the experiment config and funnel metrics. Also add a small help link on the card: "How samples work" that opens docs.

omar.eng: Dev estimate: 1.5 frontend days for UI + a11y behaviors, 0.5 backend day for persisted flag and events. Will include lazy-load for thumbnails.

riley.a11y: I'll post a short acceptance checklist for keyboard/VoiceOver/NVDA runs and contrast screenshots. Also request explicit alt text for thumbnails: don't use images as the only signal.

deploy-bot: Staging preview scheduled: 2025-02-10 09:00 UTC. Smoke tests will run post-build and link will be posted here.

sam.design: Thanks team :thumbsup:
